mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_role r WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM sys_role r WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role(role_code, role_name, description, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{role_code}, #{role_name}, #{description}, #{sort_order}, #{status}, #{created_at}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_role r ORDER BY r.sort_order, r.id
SELECT FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.sort_order, r.id

SELECT ur.user_id AS user_id, r.id AS role_id, r.role_code AS role_code, r.role_name AS role_name, r.sort_order AS sort_order FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id IN #{uid} ORDER BY ur.user_id, r.sort_order, r.id

SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_user_role(user_id, role_id, created_at) VALUES(#{userId}, #{roleId}, NOW())

mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code AS role_code, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY r.role_code ORDER BY MIN(r.sort_order), r.role_code
